headline: Xbox prices rise, Series X hits $800 in August
summary: Discounts available before price hike, Series X at $573
details: Microsoft announced that Xbox model prices will rise in August, the second increase in less than a year. The Xbox Series X with a disc drive will cost $799.99, up from $649.99.
The 1TB Xbox Series X is currently discounted to $573 at Walmart and $573.99 at Target. This model features a built-in 4K Blu-ray player.
The Xbox Series S, usually $399.99, will rise to $499.99 in August. It's currently on sale at Dell for $349.99 (512GB) and $379.99 at Target.
caption:
Xbox prices are going up in August. Can you still snag a deal?

Microsoft announced that Xbox model prices will rise in August, the second increase in less than a year. The Xbox Series X with a disc drive will cost $799.99, up from $649.99.

The 1TB Xbox Series X is currently discounted to $573 at Walmart and $573.99 at Target. This model features a built-in 4K Blu-ray player.

The Xbox Series S, usually $399.99, will rise to $499.99 in August. It's currently on sale at Dell for $349.99 (512GB) and $379.99 at Target.
